semantic_summary: BAT/BATC/BREF and BAT-AEL standards remain permit-setting evidence rather than observations.
Consultation and draft UK BAT material cannot be treated as final standards.
Permit, ELV, monitoring requirement, risk-screening PC/PEC and cost-benefit evidence cannot be promoted to measured parcel GHG.
Hydrogen fuel, fugitive hydrogen, capture rate, captured CO2, transported/stored CO2 and emitted CO2 retain separate boundaries.
Waste-battery treatment, emissions controls, monitoring frequencies, limits, energy intensity and waste tracking are distinct from absolute GHG measurements.
Crematoria BAT, operating controls, monitoring and ELVs remain distinct from annual GHG mass and cadastral parcel binding.
